metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1952 · Singin' in the Rain
metas.description: A silent film star falls for a chorus girl just as he and his delusionally jealous screen partner are trying to make the difficult transition to talking pictures in 1920s Hollywood.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1958 · Vertigo
metas.description: A former San Francisco police detective juggles wrestling with his personal demons and becoming obsessed with the hauntingly beautiful woman he has been hired to trail, who may be deeply disturbed.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1959 · Some Like It Hot
metas.description: After two male musicians witness a mob hit, they flee the state in an all-female band disguised as women, but further complications set in.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1957 · Wild Strawberries
metas.description: After living a life marked by coldness, an aging professor is forced to confront the emptiness of his existence.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1953 · Roman Holiday
metas.description: A bored and sheltered princess escapes her guardians and falls in love with an American newsman in Rome.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1959 · Hiroshima Mon Amour
metas.description: A French actress filming an anti-war film in Hiroshima has an affair with a married Japanese architect as they share their differing perspectives on war.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1951 · The African Queen
metas.description: In WWI East Africa, a gin-swilling Canadian riverboat captain is persuaded by a strait-laced English missionary to undertake a trip up a treacherous river and use his boat to attack a German gunship.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1952 · The Quiet Man
metas.description: A retired American boxer returns to the village of his birth in 1920s Ireland, where he falls for a spirited redhead whose brother is contemptuous of their union.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1951 · A Place in the Sun
metas.description: A poor boy gets a job working for his rich uncle and ends up falling in love with two women.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1954 · Sabrina
metas.description: After her return from school in Paris, a playboy finally takes notice of his family's chauffeur's daughter, who's long had a crush on him, but he questions his more serious brother's motives when he warns against getting involved ...

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1954 · White Christmas
metas.description: A successful song-and-dance team become romantically involved with a sister act and team up to save the failing Vermont inn of their former commanding general.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1953 · From Here to Eternity
metas.description: At a U.S. Army base in 1941 Hawaii, a pugilistic private is cruelly punished for refusing to join his unit's boxing team. Meanwhile, his commanding officer's wife and top NCO are indulging in a torrid love affair.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1955 · Marty
metas.description: A middle-aged butcher and a school teacher who have given up on the idea of love meet at a dance and fall for each other.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1955 · To Catch a Thief
metas.description: A retired jewel thief sets out to prove his innocence after being suspected of returning to his former occupation.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1957 · An Affair to Remember
metas.description: A couple falls in love and agrees to meet in six months at the Empire State Building - but will it happen?

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1954 · Seven Brides for Seven Brothers
metas.description: When a backwoodsman in 1850s Oregon brings a wife home to his farm, his six brothers decide that they want to get married too.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1953 · Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
metas.description: Showgirls Lorelei Lee and Dorothy Shaw travel to Paris, pursued by a private detective hired by the suspicious father of Lorelei's fiancé, as well as a rich, enamored old man and many other doting admirers.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1951 · An American in Paris
metas.description: Three friends struggle to find work in Paris. Things become more complicated when two of them fall in love with the same woman.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1955 · The Seven Year Itch
metas.description: When his family goes away for summer vacation, a hitherto faithful husband with an overactive imagination is tempted by a sexy new neighbor.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1957 · Funny Face
metas.description: An impromptu fashion shoot at a book store brings about a new fashion model discovery in the shop clerk.
